title: 第333章 风暴再临第332章 思想传授
slug: 异界冒险从组建冒险团开始
content_zh:
因为时间并不充裕，沃尔简单教授了战士们一些步伐和挥拳闪避的技巧后，便直接开始实战训练。
战斗中最基础的部分，其实已经被刻入战士们的潜意识之中，他需要做的，就是通过实战，不断将其激发出来。
当战士们不穿盔甲，不拿武器，与沃尔展开正面搏斗时，才能感受到什么叫绝对的压制，不管他们怎么挥拳，都打不中沃尔，不管怎么扭动身体躲避，也躲不开沃尔的重拳！
沃尔打过一圈后，便让战士们各种实战训练，他们实力都相差不大，打得有来有回。
作为职业者，战士们的适应能力极强，很快便开始精简自己的动作，将那些无用的晃动和闪躲舍弃，开始下意识调整距离和角度，不再出现胡乱挥拳的情况。
徒手格斗训练之后，便是冷兵器训练，除了常用的武器外，每个战士都要熟练掌握各种短兵器、单手、双手、长柄、重武器的使用，这对战士们来说并不算太难。
下午，开始远程武器的训练，由文德尔作为教官，首先便是弩机和弓箭的使用，先是熟悉配件，然后反复练习组装拆卸和上弦，最后才在院子里射击15米外的靶子。
傍晚，战士们开始练习盔甲的穿戴保养和进阶使用技巧，由矮人托姆·铁砧作为教官，先讲解一下盔甲的防御和制作原理，让战士们清楚各种盔甲的优劣，以及其防御力最强的部位和薄弱部位。
这在战斗中相当重要，当两个穿着重甲的战士交战时，不可能避开对方所有攻击，这时，就要用盔甲防御力最强的部位，当做盾牌去主动防御敌人的攻击，同时，以手中的武器去攻击对方盔甲最薄弱的部位。
这种事说起来容易做起来却很难，必须经过严格的训练，对盔甲产生条件反射，才有可能应用于战斗中。
战旗冒险团众人训练如火如荼地开展时，莉亚对沃尔的风暴巨人血脉灌注改造也在准备之中。
由于这个改造方案已经非常成熟，材料也都具备，并没有什么难度，真正令莉亚担心的，只有来自巨人之父安南的诅咒。
第三天中午，窗外黑压压一片，狂风呼啸，吹得百叶窗噼啪作响，沃尔看着手中显示最高级风暴预警的旅行时刻表，有些无奈道：
“莉亚，看来你说得没错，我们恐怕还得多待几天才行。”
莉亚一手抱着沃尔肌肉隆起的手臂，另一只手在窗前张开，感受着风的力量，轻声道：
“我们这里还算安全，帝国海岸恐怕正在遭受可怕的灾难！”
知道的越多，反而有越多烦恼，就像这场风暴，战士们只感觉耽搁自己冒险，莉亚却知道，这对于帝国海岸的居民来说，是足以与世界末日相比的浩劫！
沃尔虽然两世都生在内陆，但上辈子通信发达，对于这种夏季风暴也有所耳闻，台风和飓风的破坏性之强，比之彼得皇帝受到的“神罚”还要恐怖得多啊。
对此，沃尔也无能为力，上辈子他还能捐点小钱，让几个灾民吃上几顿饱饭，但现在，嗯……向勇气与战争之神祈祷好像也没用。
沃尔微微叹息，见莉亚长耳低垂，便轻轻揽住莉亚柔软的纤细腰肢，莉亚也环住沃尔结实的腰腹，侧头靠在沃尔鼓起的胸肌上，内心的不安和担忧逐渐平息。

现在的莉亚早已不再像刚认识那样干瘦单薄，虽然算不上丰腴，也可以说是凹凸有致了，感受着紧紧依靠着自己的柔软身躯，沃尔微微一动，不过现在还有正事要做。
窗外的风越来越大，甚至开始出现各种略显恐怖的怪异呼啸之声，然后便是大颗的雨滴落下。
沃尔抬手将窗户关好，看着沉默的莉亚，双手捧住她的脸颊，轻轻向后揉捏着精灵的长耳，四目相对，他认真道：
“莉亚，来吧！相信我！”
莉亚沉默片刻，最终还是闭上了眼睛，缓缓点头，声音平淡道：
“好，仪式需要持续6个小时左右，把冒险团的事安排好。”
沃尔嘴角微微上扬，低头深深一吻，然后拍了拍门口趴着的大狗屁股，这才下楼和战士们交代，在可能持续一周的风暴期间该做些什么。
其实也没什么特别的事，就是让战士们在屋内训练而已，不过薇拉倒是趁机向他汇报任务进度，她语气轻松道：
“团长，任务进展非常顺利，米尔已经潜伏到目标身边，西里尔这个混蛋在镇上很克制，但经常借着巡逻领地的机会勾搭附近村庄的女人，这事不大不小，但只要摆到明面上，他恐怕不能再做卫兵队长了……”
这些女人有的是主动，有的是被迫，但都不会被西里尔的哥哥所容忍。
而且米尔已经找到了西里尔藏钱的地方，名声扫地后，又没有了职位，还失去了财产，这家伙恐怕很难在领地混下去了。
沃尔点点头，吩咐道：“辛苦你们了，注意安全，不要为了这种任务让兄弟们有损伤。”
薇拉心中一暖，点头道：“是，团长。”
沃尔安排好各项事宜，并交代接下来自己有重要的事情要处理，让霍恩负责防卫工作，这才返回房间。
这时，原本还略显温馨的房间已经被清空，连床都被搬走，只剩下房间中央的一个巨大浴桶，莉亚正往其中倾倒着淡紫色的粘稠液体。
两人核对了一番仪式流程后，沃尔脱去衣物，全身浸泡入富含高能的营养液中。
原本仪式的第一步，应该是向巨人之父安南祷告，祈求其宽恕自己的罪孽，不过沃尔选择相信神器战旗的力量，所以省略了这一步骤。
巨人血脉不同于活跃而充满侵蚀性的巨龙和巨魔，非常稳定，需要持续激活，才能对受术者的身体产生永久改变，这个过程会消耗巨量能量。
紧接着，莉亚取出七管散发着紫色荧光的药剂，这便是已经做好血脉激活的风暴巨人血脉灌注液，里面并非全是液体，还有半固体的肌核肉髓，所以针管格外粗大。
沃尔咽了咽唾沫，咬咬牙道：

“来吧，莉亚，不要怜惜……”
“呃啊！”

content_en:
Because there was not enough time, Wall briefly taught the fighters some steps and punch dodge skills, and then started actual combat training directly.
The most basic parts of combat have actually been engraved into the subconscious of the soldiers. What he needs to do is to constantly stimulate them through actual combat.
When the soldiers don't wear armor or hold weapons, and fight head-on with Wall, they can feel what absolute suppression means. No matter how they punch, they can't hit Wall, and no matter how they twist their bodies to avoid, they can't avoid Wall's punch!
After Wall played a round, he asked the fighters to do various practical training. They were all about the same strength, and they fought back and forth.
As professionals, warriors are extremely adaptable. They quickly began to streamline their movements, discarding useless shaking and dodging, and began to subconsciously adjust distances and angles, eliminating random punches.
After unarmed combat training, there is cold weapon training. In addition to commonly used weapons, every warrior must be proficient in the use of various short weapons, one-handed, two-handed, long-handled, and heavy weapons. This is not too difficult for the soldiers.
In the afternoon, long-range weapons training began, with Wendel as the instructor. The first thing was the use of crossbows and bows. First, they were familiar with the accessories, and then repeatedly practiced assembly, disassembly and winding, and finally shot a target 15 meters away in the yard.
In the evening, the soldiers began to practice the wearing, maintenance and advanced use skills of armor. The dwarf Tom Anvil served as the instructor. He first explained the defense and production principles of armor, so that the soldiers knew the advantages and disadvantages of various armors, as well as their strongest and weakest defensive parts.
This is very important in combat. When two warriors wearing heavy armor fight, it is impossible to avoid all attacks from the opponent. At this time, the most defensive part of the armor must be used as a shield to actively defend against the enemy's attacks. At the same time, use the weapon in your hand to attack the weakest part of the opponent's armor.
This kind of thing is easier said than done. It must undergo strict training and produce conditioned reflexes for armor before it can be used in combat.
While the training of the members of the Banner Adventure Group was in full swing, Leah was also preparing to transform Vol's Storm Giant blood infusion.
Since this transformation plan is very mature and all the materials are available, it is not difficult. What really worries Leah is the curse from Annan, the father of the giants.
At noon on the third day, it was dark outside the window, and the wind was howling, making the blinds crackle. Wall looked at the travel timetable in his hand that showed the highest level of storm warning, and said with some helplessness:
"Lea, it seems you are right, we may have to stay for a few more days."
Leah held Wall's bulging muscle arm with one hand, and opened her other hand in front of the window, feeling the power of the wind, and whispered:
"We are relatively safe here, but the empire's coast may be suffering from a terrible disaster!"
The more they know, the more troubles they have. Just like this storm, the soldiers only feel that they are delaying their adventure, but Leah knows that for the residents of the empire coast, this is a catastrophe comparable to the end of the world!
Although Wall was born inland during his two lives, communications were developed in his previous life, and he had heard of such summer storms. The destructive power of typhoons and hurricanes was much more terrifying than the "divine punishment" suffered by Emperor Peter.
There was nothing Wall could do about this. In his previous life, he could donate a small amount of money to feed a few victims, but now, well... praying to the God of Courage and War seemed useless.
Wall sighed slightly, and seeing Leah's long ears drooping, he gently put his arms around Leah's soft and slender waist. Leah also put her arms around Wall's strong waist and leaned her head against Wall's bulging chest muscles. The uneasiness and worry in her heart gradually subsided.
Now Leah is no longer as skinny and thin as she was when we first met her. Although she is not exactly plump, she can be said to be curvy.Feeling the soft body tightly leaning on him, Wall moved slightly, but there was still business to do now.
The wind outside the window became stronger and stronger, and even began to make various strange and slightly terrifying whistling sounds, and then large raindrops fell.
Wall raised his hand to close the window, looked at the silent Leah, held her cheeks with both hands, gently kneaded the elf's long ears back, and looked at each other, he said seriously:
"Leah, come on! Trust me!"
Leah was silent for a moment, and finally closed her eyes, nodded slowly, and said in a calm voice:
"Okay, the ceremony needs to last about 6 hours. Let's make arrangements for the adventure group."
The corner of Wall's mouth slightly raised, he lowered his head and kissed deeply, then patted the big dog's butt lying at the door, and then went downstairs to explain to the soldiers what to do during the storm that might last for a week.
In fact, there was nothing special. They just let the soldiers train in the house. However, Vera took the opportunity to report the progress of the mission to him. She said in a relaxed tone:
"Captain, the mission is going very smoothly. Mir has lurked around the target. This bastard, Cyril, is very restrained in the town, but he often seduces women from nearby villages while patrolling the territory. This matter is neither big nor small, but as long as it is brought to light, he may no longer be the captain of the guard..."
Some of these women took the initiative, some were forced, but none of them would be tolerated by Cyril's brother.
Moreover, Mir has found the place where Cyril hid his money. After his reputation was ruined, he lost his position, and lost his property, it may be difficult for this guy to survive in the territory.
Wall nodded and ordered: "Thank you for your hard work. Pay attention to safety and don't let your brothers get hurt for this kind of mission."
Vera felt warm in her heart and nodded: "Yes, leader."
Wall arranged all the matters and explained that he had important things to deal with next, leaving Horn to take charge of the defense work before returning to the room.
At this time, the originally warm room had been emptied, and even the bed had been moved away, leaving only a huge bathtub in the center of the room, into which Leah was pouring lavender viscous liquid.
After the two checked the ritual process, Wall took off his clothes and soaked his whole body in the high-energy nutrient solution.
Originally, the first step in the ceremony was to pray to Annan, the father of the giants, and ask him to forgive his sins, but Wall chose to believe in the power of the artifact battle flag, so he omitted this step.
Unlike the active and corrosive dragons and trolls, the giant bloodline is very stable and requires continuous activation to produce permanent changes to the subject's body. This process consumes a huge amount of energy.
Immediately afterwards, Leah took out seven tubes of purple fluorescent medicine. These were the Storm Giant bloodline infusion fluids that had been prepared for blood vessel activation. They were not all liquid, but also had semi-solid myonuclear marrow, so the needle tubes were particularly thick.
Wall swallowed his saliva, gritted his teeth and said:
"Come on, Leah, don't show mercy..."
"Uh-huh!"
